all_blocker_reason_counts can exceed scoped_existing_source_count because one row may have multiple blockers.
source directory missing usually means the classification row points at a pre-migration path that has already moved.

scoped_archive_classification_gap is scoped_archive_skill_count minus scoped_existing_source_count; positive values indicate archive skills not covered by the classification file or duplicate classification coverage.
stable_key_conflicts detail is bounded by --conflict-detail-limit and includes content hashes so duplicate removal is not inferred from the stable key alone.
